title: Selection into Financial Education and Effects on Portfolio Choice
authors: Irina Gemmo; Pierre‐Carl Michaud; Olivia S. Mitchell
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. One-shot online survey experiment (fall 2021, 2,005 Canadian respondents) with randomized offer of a financial education module and elicited willingness to pay; outcomes are portfolio-allocation task metrics. Analyses are cross-sectional OLS/logit/IV/matching regressions of outcomes on treat_offer / treat (08-task1_regs.do, 12-task2_iv.do, 13-task2_matching.do, 14-wtp_regs.do). No panel, no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Full-text hits for 'staggered' and 'difference-in-difference' refer to pre/post task comparisons within the survey. Package ships raw survey data, pipeline scripts and manuscript sources.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.md, regressions list).
